transcript.content: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. It's nice to meet you. Could you please tell me what brings you in to see me today?

Well, nice to meet you, Dr. Smith. My family, they brought me in because of a... well, an incident at the fair. 

I was giving my talk, and I just climbed right up onto the tractor. I kept jerking the controls around, trying to show the crowd this new pattern. People were yelling at me to get down and stop, but I... I just couldn't make myself stop doing it. So, that's why I'm here.
When you were on that tractor, did you feel like you were hearing voices or receiving special messages that others couldn't hear or see?

Well, on the tractor... I'm not sure about right then. But I do hear voices, yes. Mostly when I'm out by the north pasture. 

Especially right around dusk, I'll hear these clear voices coming straight out of the irrigation lines. They tell me... well, they tell me exactly which rows are poisoned and which ones are blessed. And the thing is, it's not just when I'm all fired up and acting like I was at the fair. It still happens on weeks when I'm feeling completely normal.
Have there been significant periods of time, lasting at least two weeks, where you experienced these voices even when you were not feeling overly excited, energetic, or down in the dumps?

Yeah, there have been. I can think of several quieter weeks, actually, where I wasn't feeling especially energized or grand or anything like that. I wasn't down in the dumps either, just... going about my regular chores. 

But even during those weeks, I still heard the lines talking to me out by the pasture. And I still fully believed that the farm data I was looking at was carrying hidden warnings. So, the voices and the warnings about the crops, they stuck around even when my mood was just fine.

Looking back over the entire time you've been dealing with these voices and these beliefs, would you say that the periods where you felt 'fired up' or unusually energetic have occupied a large portion of your total illness, or were they relatively brief compared to the times you felt like your normal self?

If I really look back at the whole stretch of it... I'd say it's been a large portion, yes. Actually, for most of this whole time, I've been running on that... that really charged, driven feeling. I'd be making all these big plans for the property, and just snapping at anyone who tried to slow me down. So, yeah, those energized times definitely weren't brief. They've been going on for the majority of it.
Have you ever gone through a period of at least two weeks where you felt deeply sad, hopeless, or lost interest in all your usual activities, even when you weren't feeling 'fired up' or energized?

No, I can't say I have. I mean, farming is tough work, and you have your bad days, but... I haven't had any stretches like that where I was just completely down and out, or too sad to get out of bed. It's mostly just been the voices and that really high energy I was talking about.
Have you ever had a stretch of time where you felt that same high energy and 'fired up' feeling, but you were NOT hearing the voices or feeling like the farm data was giving you hidden warnings?

No, I don't... I don't think they were ever separate. When I had that high energy, the other stuff was right there with it. 

Like, during the months when I was sleeping hardly at all, just pushing the farm expansion day and night... I was also hearing those voices in the irrigation lines. And I was still reading those warnings in the yield maps at the exact same time. So, no, they definitely happened together.

Looking back at the entire duration of your illness, have there been any periods of at least two weeks where you experienced the voices and the special messages about the farm data, but you did NOT have any of that high energy or 'fired up' feeling?

Well, if I think about it... yes. There were some quieter weeks in there. I wasn't feeling especially energized or making all those big plans, just kind of going about my regular work. But even during those couple of weeks when my energy was just normal, I still heard the irrigation lines talking to me. And I still knew the farm data was carrying those hidden warnings. So the voices and the messages didn't stop just because I wasn't feeling fired up.
